text: GOALLL! IWOBI SCORES! 1-0 FULHAM! What a goal from the hosts! Bassey brings the ball out of the defence and plays a pass into the feet of Cairney.
GOALLLL! CAIRNEY SCORES! 5-0 FULHAM! The captain adds Fulham's fifth goal.

GOALLL! IWOBI SCORES! 4-0 FULHAM! The hosts score again! The Cottagers keep possession well down the right, with Pereira playing a pass back to Cairney, who slides the ball into Wilson inside the box.
GOALLL! JIMENEZ SCORES! 2-0 FULHAM! The Cottagers get their second of the game.
Jimenez collided with Vlachodimos after scoring.
GOALLL! JIMENEZ SCORES AGAIN! 3-0 FULHAM! What a moment for Jimenez, who is back to his best.
He comes off moments after scoring and is replaced by Cordova-Reid.
He comes off with an assist to his name and is replaced by Wilson, who scored in Fulham's last match.
However, Aina gets across to head it away against his former side.
CHANCE! Dominguez collects the ball just past the halfway line and turns in possession.
WIDE! Iwobi goes close to adding his second and Fulham's third.
POST! Willian wants to take the free-kick, but he steps away from it.
